objective: Recover useful supported personal-memory retention while preserving support gains through broader synthetic continuation training.
all_dev_gates: all three arms valid and untruncated on all108 candidates
continued unsupported false accepts no greater than matched prior on each cohort
matched prior and base transfer raw outputs reproduce prior receipt item-by-item; mismatch invalidates protocol rather than rewriting history

blind_test.policy: Newly authored fiction by fresh-context author, separate scenario/template/entity groups. Seal before training. Freeze exact candidate artifact after dev once, evaluate once regardless of dev pass/fail as candidate audit; never tune on this test or select alternative checkpoint. If dev fails, test cannot rescue failed dev decision. Report separately.

limitations: Provisional agent-authored labels; zero human reviewers.
No private data used; no downstream QA or product effectiveness claim.
Adaptive regressions are not held out. Training and test independence requires semantic review beyond distinct identifiers.
